claim_title: Reference-input set is a concept-faithful component summary (ResNet-50 / ImageNet)

figures.caption: C1/P1a — last-layer top-1 concept-purity vs k (ImageNet class-name text queries; random baseline ≈ 0.001). Peaks at k=16 (89.8%), declines at k=256 (68.9%), supporting the 'small set is a concept-faithful summary' phrasing.
C1/P1b — hidden-layer matched-control cosine gap Δ_sep (top-1 vs top-2 concept) at k=16. layer4 gap 0.0202 (p≈0), layer3 gap 0.0049 (p≈0); both significant but layer3 magnitude is small.
